The Oral Pathology (Upper-grade) A-D courses will generally follow the same format. However, the content may vary depending on the timing of enrollment, as clinical cases may be used. The goal is to acquire more practical knowledge, experimental techniques, and principles using clinical cases and published research data, and to gain the foundation for writing research papers.
履修条件
Those who understand the fundamentals of pathology and wish to take this course with a strong desire to learn.
When studying, please keep the following points in mind:
Since the content is introductory, please study related subjects before taking this course.
This course is at an advanced level, so you should have studied related subjects, including Oral Pathology (Lower-grade) and Oral Pathology (Core) courses, before enrolling.
Please also plan to take other Oral Pathology (Upper-grade) B-D courses.
授業概要
臨床で病理組織診が行われた症例を用いて診断根拠となる病理所見を確認し、診断の妥当性、治療や予後の基本的項目について検討を行う。併せて、臨床所見や画像所見との比較を行う。
関連する文献を用いて、基本的な仮説設定、研究手技や研究戦略などの考察を行う。
また、病理診断や治療での問題点や疑問点を鑑み、それらを基本とした研究発想や実施に取り組めるかなどの検討を試みる。
This course is held to understand the pathogenesis and the cause of death based on the autopsy findings in the clinico-pathological conference (CPC). And in the joint conference of the oral maxillofacial surgery, radiology and pathology, it is aimed to understand the pathogenic mechanism, progress and prognosis of the disease to learn how to make the histopathological diagnosis of the disease occurring in the head and neck, which was sampled or extirpated in the dental departments of Kyushu University Hospital.
Using relevant literature, basic hypothesis setting, research techniques and strategies will be discussed.
In addition, in light of the problems and questions in pathological diagnosis and clinical treatment, we will attempt to examine whether we can work on research ideas and implementation based on these issues.

授業形態
（内容）
This course teaches practical procedures for handling pathological specimens and performing pathological diagnostics, enabling students to actually diagnose the lesion histopathologically and approach the nature of the lesion. It also aims to further broaden students' knowledge of related reagents and equipment.
The course will be conducted through lectures and practical exercises either in person or
online.
Assignments may be given via email, and students may be required to submit reports.
使用する教材等
Textbooks (paper format), slide materials (electronic format), image materials, and materials
prepared by students for assignments (such as research papers and materials extracted
from public databases)
全体の教育目標
The goal is to acquire knowledge about diseases occurring in the maxillofacial region and to well-understand practical approaches to diagnosis and treatment planning.
The goal is to understand the following points regarding diseases occurring in the maxillofacial region and to be able to apply this knowledge clinically:
1. Understanding the basics of disease pathogenesis.
2. Being able to practice diagnostic procedures based on an understanding of basic pathogenesis.
3. Being able to grasp the disease state and basic treatment methods based on the results of examinations and tests.
4. Understanding basic pathological examination and analysis methods.
